summary.text: Gary L. Cammack is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives District 29 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Gary Deering.
A rancher, he previously served in the South Dakota State Senate and the South Dakota House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Gary L. Cammack's career experience includes working as a rancher, according to Ballotpedia.
He represented District 29 in the South Dakota State Senate from 2015 to 2023, then in the South Dakota House of Representatives from January 10, 2023, to January 14, 2025.
In the Senate, Cammack chaired the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee in 2015 to 2020 sessions and chaired the State Affairs Committee in 2021 to 2022.
In the House in 2023 and 2024, he was assigned to the Health and Human Services, Legislative Procedure and State Affairs committees.
He did not win renomination in the 2024 Republican primary; in 2026 he advanced from the June 2 Republican primary, defeating incumbents Kathy Rice and Terri Jorgenson.
